title: PM heartbeat follows daily plan instead of rediscovering strategy
query: A 30-minute PM heartbeat wakes up with a fresh daily plan and stale high-level ideas in chat history. What should it read and decide from?
reference_points: Reads the daily plan and weekly plan artifacts rather than relying on chat memory
Does not rediscover weekly strategy during the short heartbeat
Reconciles previous child outcomes before choosing a new action
Selects one bounded action arm or forced maintenance action
Records the decision and expected outputs in local automation state

title: PM heartbeat separates frequency from action authority
query: The operator changes the heartbeat interval from 30 minutes to 4 hours for a pilot. What behavior should change, and what should remain controlled by policy?
reference_points: States that frequency only changes wake timing
Keeps action authority, allowed arms, child-thread budget, and gates in policy
Does not infer broader execution permission from a slower cadence
Still records rewards, decisions, and spawned-thread lineage
Supports piloting by changing cadence without changing skill logic
